environment: Native Three camera projection and follow math; browser checks recorded separately

checks.name: perspective camera shows nearby objects larger than distant objects
eye is about 34 degrees above ground and north remains screen-up
whole player remains visible on desktop and phone world aspect ratios, including map edges
player fills roughly a fifth of the frame at the closer follow distance
walking follow is monotonic and settles without overshooting
reduced motion follows immediately and a new area resets the camera target
camera update leaves map and gameplay data untouched and loads before scene setup
conversation eases closer around both participants and returns to walking camera
conversation keeps both full characters above the dialogue panel at three aspect ratios
reduced motion changes conversation framing immediately without mutating participants
